root_cause.mechanism: When vault totalSupply is 0 or low, an attacker deposits 1 wei of assets to receive 1 share, then donates a massive asset balance directly to the vault. Subsequent user deposits round down to 0 shares due to integer division (assets * totalSupply / totalAssets), forfeiting funds to the attacker.

preconditions.description: Vault total supply is 0 or can be completely drained to 0.
Vault accounting relies on balanceOf(address(this)) rather than an internal tracked balance, or allows direct donations.
Share calculation rounds down to 0 without reverting on 0 minted shares.

mitigations.name: Virtual Shares & Offset
mitigations.mechanism: Implement OpenZeppelin ERC4626 _decimalsOffset() or initialize vault with virtual shares (e.g., 1000 shares dead-minted to address(0xdead)).
mitigations.code_example: function _decimalsOffset() internal view virtual returns (uint8) { return 3; }

mitigations.name: Zero Shares Mint Check
mitigations.mechanism: Revert transaction if minted shares is zero.
